Text-only regressions intact; real providers and concurrent tests verified; no secrets in metadata/confirmation/logs; no unplanned Agent or source-budget changes.

Reuse prior test infrastructure; no new test-only production seams.

Not applicable for docs/review; verify preceding operation reuse assessments and no duplicate implementation. Final approval does not authorize commit/push/merge.

Follow authoritative validation lifecycle; feature E2E authoring waits for final review task, but focused tests are immediate. Agent selection and #875 acquisition budgets are outside scope. No global configuration mutation.
